title: Spooked
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Halloween-themed episode, Andy sets strict rules for costumes and vetoes Kevin's gorilla outfit to avoid spoilers. Erin struggles with feeling sidelined as Angela and Phyllis take over the party planning, while Jim reluctantly joins a group costume. Pam shares a ghost story, and Robert probes characters about their fears and feelings during the party. The episode also features a spooky story from Robert and culminates with Bert abruptly firing Toby, revealing his authority as the CEO's son.
